title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content: Cover image: Two inquisitive Florida Scrub-Jays. Many Florida Scrub-Jays first gain breeding positions by inheriting territory. Modern spatial analysis reveals that both females as well as males acquire territory and breeding positions through inheritance but do so through different strategies. For more information, see “Multiple routes to territory inheritance in the Florida Scrub-Jay (Aphelocoma coerulescens), https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2656.70268”. Photograph provided by Joseph Krell.
